result:
Five merged PRs since 2026-04-16 added or removed a line containing `voidedValue` under `src`. Best first:

1. **#822** (O3-6030, "Keep hidden obs group members, orders and diagnoses out of submissions"), merged 2026-10-02. Changes `prepareOrders` and `prepareDiagnosis` to use `voidedValue` only for hidden fields that were cleared, and `processObsGroup` to read `member.meta.submission.voidedValue` in place of `nestedField.meta.submission.voidedValue`. See `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/processors/encounter/encounter-processor-helper.ts:297-298` and `:436-437`.
2. **#842** (O3-5847, "Stop unchanged obs values from creating duplicate obs"), merged 2026-10-13. Adds the "values fed back after loading" block, whose assertions on `voidedValue` are at `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/adapters/obs-adapter.test.ts:1566-1921`.
3. **#826** (O3-6027, "Clear order and diagnosis submissions on every write"), merged 2026-10-05. Replaces `toBe(undefined)` with `toBeNull()` on a `voidedValue` assertion at `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/adapters/encounter-diagnosis-adapter.test.ts:206`. The same PR also rewrites `voidedValue` assertions in `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/processors/encounter/encounter-payloads.golden.test.ts`.
4. **#812** ("Add tests to cover form submission orchestration"), merged 2026-09-22. Creates `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/provider/form-factory-helper.test.ts` (`voidedValue` at lines 49 and 57) and adds the `voidedValue: null` helper at `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/processors/encounter/encounter-form-processor.test.ts:34`.
5. **#787** ("Add golden schemas for encounter payloads"), merged 2026-08-20. Creates `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/processors/encounter/encounter-payloads.golden.test.ts` (`voidedValue` at lines 551, 1524, 1531) and adds `voidedValue` lines to `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/processors/encounter/encounter-processor-helper.test.ts`.

Dates are the main-branch commit dates from `list_commits`. I did not check the PR API, so these may not be the exact merge timestamps if the PRs were not squash-merged.

Checked and excluded: #756 (b99cb4c) created `encounter-processor-helper.test.ts` without any `voidedValue` line. #843 (c0c4765) changed `form-factory-helper.test.ts` without touching a `voidedValue` line. 12c24b6 has no PR number, so it is not a merged PR.

Limits: the full-range diff was too large to read, so I checked per file, not per line across all 37 `src` commits. I used the default branch head (b0d8fd2) as the pinned head, since that is the latest `src` commit.
